criteria.requirement: Add FieldRenamer(mapping,conflict="error"/"keep"/"overwrite") processor in structlog.processors. Freeze string mapping, reject duplicate destinations, ignore absent sources, apply all moves from original snapshot so swaps/chains work. Default external destination collision raises before any mutation; keep retains conflicting source/destination and transitively prevents moves into newly retained fields; overwrite explicitly replaces destination. Return independent outer dict preserving payload identity and untouched source; existing EventRenamer unchanged.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
